user_story: As a user, I want task creation to fail when the title is empty so that all tasks have a meaningful name.

positive.title: Create a task with a non-empty title
steps: Navigate to the task creation page
Enter a non-empty title in the title field
positive.expected_result: Task is created successfully with the specified title

negative.title: Attempt to create a task with an empty title
steps: Navigate to the task creation page
negative.expected_result: Task creation fails with an error message indicating that the title cannot be empty

edge.title: Attempt to create a task with a very long title
steps: Navigate to the task creation page
Enter a very long string as the title in the title field
edge.expected_result: Task is created successfully, or an appropriate message is displayed if the title exceeds the maximum length limit
